statement: Each placed request Binding actual becomes a Cell only after the existing RuntimeDriverRegistry, WasmComponentDriver, and ServiceRuntimeLifecycle path has loaded and instantiated its exact package_id, manifest_digest, manifest-pinned OCI payload, and export as a genuine WASI Component, enforced its declared table context, derived capabilities, and budgets, and projected that same services actual ACTIVE and healthy; the live minimal-deployment-request-cell-runtime-readiness scenario observes component-produced declared table effects, denial of undeclared access and budget exhaustion, restart and replay reconvergence to one ready and running instance, and typed startup failures remaining non-ready.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Extend RuntimeDriverRegistry, WasmComponentDriver, ServiceRuntimeLifecycle, and their existing collaborators; reuse or extend the install catalog, Artifact resolver and cache, capability authority, and canonical table/query owners; do not add a Cell scheduler, replica table, lifecycle owner, runtime registry, feature-local Artifact cache, per-Cell state store, or shadow readiness state.

A Binding-derived wasm_component actual must load and execute genuine component bytes whose package_id, manifest_digest, manifest-pinned OCI payload digest, and export all match the immutable Binding target; JavaScript envelopes, missing-lifecycle success, bookkeeping-only health, test-only runtime paths, and feature-flagged fallback remain forbidden.

The runtime owner path must enforce the exact Binding budgets and owner-derived capabilities at the genuine component boundary and expose only the declared export-bounded table context; receiving or copying policy metadata without denying undeclared table or capability access and representative budget exhaustion is not completion.

Restart, redelivery, and placement replay must idempotently re-establish the exact pinned component with at most one live engine instance, handler registration, and services actual per replica identity, clean partial prepare/start effects, and treat operation-journal success as non-authoritative after runtime effects evaporate; otherwise the owner must keep the exact actual non-ready with a typed failure.

Readiness must be evaluated from the current exact actual and genuine engine health after every await; unavailable bytes, corrupt or mismatched identity, policy denial, budget exhaustion, and startup failure must produce owner-authored typed retryable or terminal outcomes under existing budgets, and stale cache state or prior journal success must never admit ACTIVE or healthy.

The proof must go red at the genuine-component or readiness assertion after engaging the production owner path, exercise real component bytes rather than a JavaScript export envelope, bind the bytes and export to the immutable Artifact identity, show the same actual non-ready before instantiation and after every negative case, show component-produced declared table effects plus denied undeclared access and representative budget exhaustion, and preserve all admission fields in hand-authored fixtures.

This Quest may establish and exercise the single runtime invocation owner needed to prove genuine execution, but it must not add external HTTP request ingress, Binding route selection, or client request delivery; minimal-deployment-request-cell-routing owns that cutover.
Activation of change, time, once, boot, call, and pushdown Bindings and elastic learner placement remain outside this Quest.
